commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
90+2' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
89' The attendance is 73738.
89' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is hurriedly cleared.

88' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester Utd can continue in their attacking effort.
87' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
84' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
83' Great teamplay by Manchester Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
81' Casemiro (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
80' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner with a short pass.

79' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Manchester Utd win a corner.
78' Mason Mount (Manchester United) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.

78' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Ederson makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the roof of the net.
76' Mason Mount (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee John Brooks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' Nico O'Reilly comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilkay Gundogan departs the field of play to be replaced by Jack Grealish (Manchester City).
71' Ruben Amorim decides to make a substitution. Rasmus Hojlund will be replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mason Mount (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Manuel Ugarte cannot continue after picking up an injury.

71' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Ederson scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
70' John Brooks blows his whistle. Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) commits a foul after dangerous play.

69' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the middle of the goal. Andre Onana is alert and makes a good save to deny him.
69' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
68' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
67' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation. Manchester City have been awarded a free kick.
65' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Andre Onana to dive and make a save.
64' The referee blows his whistle as Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) was too aggressive in his challenge. Manchester City earn a free kick.
62' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
61' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
60' A cross from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
59' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
59' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Manchester Utd have a corner.
58' Here is a change. Harry Maguire is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
57' Substitution. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) in, Phil Foden out.
57' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when John Brooks blows for a foul.
56' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Andre Onana.
55' A player from Manchester Utd commits a rough challenge. John Brooks blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Manchester City have a free kick.
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ederson intercepts the ball.

54' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Manchester Utd, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
53' The shot by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Andre Onana.
52' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Casemiro (Manchester United) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
51' Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
49' A pass by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
48' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
48' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ederson is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) for his blatant foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' John Brooks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Manchester City will take a free kick near the side line.
44' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) jumps into a tackle and John Brooks signals a foul. Free kick. Manchester Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
42' John Brooks interrupts the game. One of the players from Manchester City won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Manchester Utd win a free kick.
41' Casemiro (Manchester United) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Ederson is well positioned to make a comfortable save.

40' Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
38' Manchester Utd move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
35' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Manchester City are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester City.
30' Flag up against Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
30' Manchester Utd are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
29' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
27' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
25' A player from Manchester Utd commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
23' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
22' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
19' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to release Omar Marmoush with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
19' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.

18' That didn't go as planned! Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Andre Onana, who easily kept it out.
17' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Manchester Utd will take a throw-in.
15' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
15' Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Now Manchester City have a corner.
15' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
12' Looks like Phil Foden (Manchester City) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

11' The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick. Good team movement sets up Phil Foden (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
9' Flag goes up against Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Manchester City decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
7' Rough tackle by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City are awarded the free kick.

7' Manchester City slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
6' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Manchester Utd.
5' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' A quickly taken corner by Manchester Utd.

3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Dias (Manchester City) was quite harsh and John Brooks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
1' The first half has just begun.
